meta.name: add-deltachat
meta.description: Add DeltaChat channel integration via @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge. Email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption.

copy.tagline: 接入端到端加密的邮件消息通道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要在应用中接入端到端加密邮件消息。
copy.tagline_en: Add an email-based encrypted messaging channel to your app.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add an email-based encrypted messaging channel to your app.

howto.what: 给项目接入 DeltaChat 通道适配器：bot 用专用邮箱收发 DeltaChat 消息，走 Autocrypt/OpenPGP 端到端加密；支持文件附件、邀请链接或二维码加好友，管理员可用 /set-avatar 换头像。
howto.when: 当你要给项目加入 DeltaChat 通道（复制适配器、安装 @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server、配置邮箱凭据、构建验证）时接管；之后用 /init-first-agent 或 /manage-channels 把聊天接到 agent。

say.text: 帮我接入 DeltaChat 通道，并把邀请链接和二维码给我
把刚收到的 DeltaChat 私聊接到一个新 agent
用这张图配合 /set-avatar 换掉 bot 头像
say.note: 仅 owner 或全局 admin 可用

howto.what_en: Adds the DeltaChat channel: the bot exchanges DeltaChat messages over a dedicated email account with Autocrypt/OpenPGP end-to-end encryption. Supports file attachments, invite link/QR join, and /set-avatar for admins.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you add the DeltaChat channel to your project: copy the adapter, install @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server, set email credentials, then wire a chat with /init-first-agent or /manage-channels.

say_en.text: Add the DeltaChat channel and give me the invite link and QR code
say_en.note: Installs the adapter and logs the invite URL and QR SVG

say_en.text: Wire the DeltaChat DM I just got to a new agent
say_en.note: Runs /init-first-agent after looking up the messaging_group

say_en.text: Use this image with /set-avatar to change the bot avatar
